# Identity Providers: References

Always prefer current vendor documentation for the installed version. Configuration keys, defaults, and
admin UI layouts change between releases. Re-verify links and contents when updating this skill.

Last verified: 2026-10-31

## Vendor (authoritative)

### Authentik

- Documentation: https://docs.goauthentik.io/
- Security policy (supported release lines, disclosure): https://docs.goauthentik.io/security/policy/
- Security advisories: https://github.com/goauthentik/authentik/security/advisories
- Release notes: https://docs.goauthentik.io/releases/
- Docker Compose installation (default ports, `akadmin`, secret key, Docker socket warning): https://docs.goauthentik.io/install-config/install/docker-compose/
- Forward auth (single application vs. domain level): https://docs.goauthentik.io/add-secure-apps/providers/proxy/forward_auth/
- Outposts: https://docs.goauthentik.io/add-secure-apps/outposts/
- Release 2025.10 (Redis removed): https://docs.goauthentik.io/releases/2025.10/

### Authelia

- Documentation: https://www.authelia.com/
- Access control (default policy, rule order, bypass): https://www.authelia.com/configuration/security/access-control/
- Security-sensitive values (file-based secrets): https://www.authelia.com/configuration/prologue/security-sensitive-values/
- Server (default listen address, health endpoint): https://www.authelia.com/configuration/miscellaneous/server/
- Regulation (brute-force protection): https://www.authelia.com/configuration/security/regulation/
- Proxy integration guides: https://www.authelia.com/integration/proxies/introduction/
- OpenID Connect provider: https://www.authelia.com/configuration/identity-providers/openid-connect/provider/
- Releases: https://github.com/authelia/authelia/releases
- Security advisories: https://github.com/authelia/authelia/security/advisories

### Keycloak

- Server guides: https://www.keycloak.org/guides
- Configuring Keycloak for production: https://www.keycloak.org/server/configuration-production
- Reverse proxy (paths to expose and not expose, proxy headers): https://www.keycloak.org/server/reverseproxy
- Bootstrap admin and recovery: https://www.keycloak.org/server/bootstrap-admin-recovery
- Hostname configuration (separate admin hostname): https://www.keycloak.org/server/hostname
- Management interface (port 9000): https://www.keycloak.org/server/management-interface
- Server administration guide (realms, clients, brute force, events): https://www.keycloak.org/docs/latest/server_admin/
- Security advisories: https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/security/advisories
- Downloads and releases: https://www.keycloak.org/downloads

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents.

## Standards

- OAuth 2.0 Security Best Current Practice (RFC 9700; exact redirect URI matching, PKCE): https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9700
- PKCE (RFC 7636): https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7636
- OpenID Connect Core: https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html

## Third-party (not authoritative)

- Community "homelab SSO" guides and Compose templates are common but often outdated (old Authelia
  endpoints, Authentik Redis containers, Keycloak `start-dev`). Use them to find what to check; verify
  every setting against the vendor documentation for the installed version.
